title: Connect your AI agent
description: Paste one line into Claude Code, Cursor or Codex. The agent sets killBottleneck up by itself, and from then on you build maps by talking to it – “make a map out of these meeting notes”.
line: Set up killBottleneck for me: fetch and follow this guide {{url}}/agent-setup.md
copied: Copied. Now paste it to your agent.
copyManual: Copying failed – select the text and copy it by hand.
afterCopy: When the agent is done, you sign in in your browser and approve the access. No password or key ever goes into the agent.
later: You can find this any time in the menu under your name.
